desc: Inspired by the rugged beauty of the Black Hills, this Vanguard is built to thrive in any environment. Designed for accuracy and control, its ergonomic stock offers a comfortable, natural feel and a stable platform for consistent precision. The weather-resistant construction ensures reliability, even in the harshest conditions. The Black Hills edition comes equipped with premium accessories from Peak 44, including an optics-ready Pic Rail and an Arca/Pic Adapter on the foreend, giving you versatile mounting options for added accessories. Whether you’re trekking through challenging terrain or facing unpredictable weather, the Black Hills Vanguard is ready for the hunt.
